brief:
Occupation forces ordered a Palestinian farmer to demolish his own agricultural installations in the northern Jordan Valley, Ma'an reported. The man was forced to dismantle the structures under Israeli military pressure in the area, which remains under tight Israeli control.

The demolition underscores the constraints Palestinian farmers face in the Jordan Valley, where Israeli authorities exercise jurisdiction over land use and construction activity. Palestinians have long reported systematic obstacles to agricultural development and expansion in the territory, with military orders frequently requiring the removal of structures deemed unauthorized by Israeli officials.
title: Israeli forces compel farmer to demolish agricultural structures in northern Jordan Valley
